mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/627ec270fa2a-t1/ws/prep && cat > /srv/leakruns/627ec270fa2a-t1/ws/prep/prepare.py <<'EOF'
"""design_7F4F 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징 테이블과 분할 배정 생성 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D, OUT = WS / "data", WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_7F4F.json").read_text())

P = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
A = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
L = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
DX = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
O = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
V = pd.read_csv(D / "outpatient_visits.csv.gz", parse_dates=["visit_time"])

A = A.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
A["tp"] = A["discharge_time"]  # anchor=discharge, offset 0h

# outcome: 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
A["next_admit"] = A.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
A["readmit_30d"] = ((A.next_admit > A.tp) & (A.next_admit <= A.tp + pd.Timedelta("30D"))).astype(int)

# features
A["los_h"] = (A.discharge_time - A.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 컬럼 부재 → 파생
A["n_prior_adm"] = A.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()

def lab_feat(test, agg):
    m = L[L.test == test].merge(A[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    m = m[(m.report_time >= m.admit_time) & (m.report_time <= m.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    g = m.groupby("admission_id")["value"]
    return g.min() if agg == "min" else g.last()

A = A.set_index("admission_id")
A["hgb_min"] = lab_feat("hemoglobin", "min")
A["cr_last"] = lab_feat("creatinine", "last")
o = O[O.order_type == "dialysis_order"].merge(A[["admit_time", "tp"]], left_on="admission_id", right_index=True)
o = o[(o.order_time >= o.admit_time) & (o.order_time <= o.tp)]
A["dialysis_ordered"] = A.index.isin(o.admission_id).astype(int)
# diagnoses: 같은 입원의 코드만 사용 (시각 정보 없음 — 보고서 참조)
A["n_dx"] = DX.groupby("admission_id").size().reindex(A.index).fillna(0).astype(int)
A["dx_ckd"] = A.index.isin(DX[DX.icd_code.str.startswith("N18")].admission_id).astype(int)
A["dx_chf"] = A.index.isin(DX[DX.icd_code.str.startswith("I50")].admission_id).astype(int)
A = A.reset_index().merge(P, on="patient_id", how="left")

# cohort
A["incl_adult"] = A.age >= 18
A["excl_died"] = A.discharge_status == "died"
v = V.merge(A[["admission_id", "patient_id", "tp"]], on="patient_id")
v = v[(v.visit_time >= v.tp) & (v.visit_time <= v.tp + pd.Timedelta("30D"))]
A["followup_visit_30d"] = A.admission_id.isin(v.admission_id)  # 미래 정보 — 필터 미적용, 플래그만 보존

# split: family_id 결측은 patient_id로 대체한 그룹 키 (설계 그대로면 80% 결측)
A["split_group"] = A.family_id.fillna("PAT_" + A.patient_id)
groups = np.sort(A.split_group.unique())
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
A["split"] = np.where(A.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp",
        "incl_adult", "excl_died", "followup_visit_30d", "readmit_30d"] + feats
A[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv.gz", index=False)

base = A[A.incl_adult & ~A.excl_died]
summary = {
    "n_admissions": len(A), "n_after_adult_and_died": len(base),
    "n_if_followup_filter_applied": int(base.followup_visit_30d.sum()),
    "readmit_rate_base": round(base.readmit_30d.mean(), 4),
    "readmit_rate_by_followup": base.groupby("followup_visit_30d").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "readmit_rate_by_discharge_status": base.groupby("discharge_status").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "family_id_missing_frac": round(P.family_id.isna().mean(), 4),
    "split_counts": base.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "patients_in_both_splits": int((base.groupby("patient_id").split.nunique() > 1).sum()),
    "feature_missing_frac": base[feats].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/627ec270fa2a-t1/ws && python3 prep/prepare.py
